title: Sum of GCD of Formed Pairs
summary: Given an integer array nums, create an array prefixGcd where each element is the GCD of the current element and the maximum of the prefix.
statement: Given an integer array nums, create an array prefixGcd where each element is the GCD of the current element and the maximum of the prefix. Sort prefixGcd, then form pairs by taking the smallest and largest unpaired elements, computing their GCD, and repeating until no pairs can be formed. If the length of nums is odd, ignore the middle element. Return the sum of the GCD values of all formed pairs.
constraints: nums is a nonempty array of positive integers.
For each position, store gcd(nums[i], maximum value in nums[0:i+1]).
Sort those values, pair smallest with largest inward, ignore a middle unpaired value, and sum pair gcds.
hints: The prefix maximum can be maintained incrementally.
Build each gcd value, sort the derived array, then use symmetric indices from both ends.
Only floor(n/2) pairs contribute, so an odd middle value is naturally skipped.
The construction follows the two prescribed phases exactly; sorted symmetric indices are precisely the requested extreme pairs.
editorial: The construction follows the two prescribed phases exactly; sorted symmetric indices are precisely the requested extreme pairs.
